existingReason: typed-generics and callback: PkFieldGroup<TItem> is the typed wrapper over pk-field-group (Razor cannot bind a markup tag when a generic and a non-generic component share a name, so the typed component is the only PkFieldGroup). PkFieldSpec<TItem> items and the model become the element's fields and values, Search runs through PkCallbackSlot, and committed changes go back through each spec's Set. Missing generator feature: @typeparam generation with a typed model adapter (and a callback parameter kind with an adapter for the element's argument and result), as for PkLookupPicker.

params.name: Fields
params.note: The typed specs; each becomes one entry of the element's fields (PkFieldDef).

params.name: Model
params.note: The bound record: each spec's Get gives the element's values, each pk-field-change calls Set.

fieldMembers.name: Required
fieldMembers.doc: The field must have a value.

fieldMembers.name: Min
fieldMembers.doc: The minimum of the control, as text.

fieldMembers.name: Max
fieldMembers.doc: The maximum of the control, as text.

fieldMembers.name: Step
fieldMembers.doc: The step of the control, as text.

fieldMembers.name: MaxLength
fieldMembers.doc: The maximum length of the control's text.

fieldMembers.name: Pattern
fieldMembers.doc: The pattern the control's text must match.

fieldMembers.name: Rows
fieldMembers.doc: The rows of a textarea; the control's own default when unset.

fieldMembers.name: Free
fieldMembers.doc: A combobox accepts the typed text itself as its value.

fieldMembers.name: Span
fieldMembers.doc: The field fills the whole row of a multi-column group.

fieldMembers.name: HideLabel
fieldMembers.doc: Hides the label visually and keeps it as the control's accessible name.

fieldMembers.name: Format
fieldMembers.doc: An input kind's format; "money" shows the number as currency while the value stays the plain number.

fieldMembers.name: Decimals
fieldMembers.doc: Fraction digits of the money format.

fieldMembers.name: Currency
fieldMembers.doc: The ISO 4217 currency code of the money format.

fieldMembers.name: Locale
fieldMembers.doc: The BCP 47 locale of the money format.

notes: PkFieldGroup<TItem> (Components/PkFieldGroup.razor) wraps pk-field-group 1:1: the controls, the conditional rendering, the form value and the validation are the element's. When, Disabled, ReadOnly, HelpWhen, LabelWhen and OptionsSource are read on every render and sent as data; LabelAction is slotted as label-action-<key>; Search is the element's search callback.
